name: Von Restorff Effect (Isolation Effect)
axiom: An item that differs from its neighbors is remembered better than the items around it.
trigger: One row, button, or price is remembered while identical neighbors blur together.

checklist.text: Emphasize one item per view; every extra highlight competes with the one meant to stand out.
Match the emphasis to the decision: the row people must recall gets the weight.
Test recall a day later, when the standout item is what remains.

antiPattern.violation: Every plan card is bright blue, so none of the three is remembered.
antiPattern.remediation: Only the recommended plan is filled; the other two stay outlined.

parametricParams.caption: ONE ITEM STANDS OUT AND IS REMEMBERED

academicOrigin.title: Über die Wirkung von Bereichsbildungen im Spurenfeld
